app.name: Super Mona
app.short_description: Run, jump and stomp through 32 stages. Hold the remote sideways.
app.long_description: An original side-scrolling platformer. Run, jump and stomp through 32 stages across eight worlds as Mona (or Ducky the rubber duck). Hold the Wiimote sideways: the D-pad runs, 1 and 2 jump and run, HOME quits. Written in Clojure (jolt), ported from the GitHub Universe 2026 badge game.
